title: Prompt source placeholders: client, store and server allowlist must change together
answers: Why does register_prompt start failing with 400 after I changed the dummy source value?
Where are the placeholder source values for prompt versions defined and used?
How do I add a new prompt sender that does not use a real artifact source?
Which UI and Python call sites send the fixed source string for prompt model versions?
body:
Path: Prompt version creation from MlflowClient.register_prompt (mlflow/tracking/client.py), AbstractStore.create_prompt_version (mlflow/store/model_registry/abstract_store.py), and the UI prompt-creation call in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/prompts/api.ts all send a fixed placeholder source to the CreateModelVersion endpoint.
Rule: The two Python senders import _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('dummy-source') and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('prompt-template') from mlflow/prompt/constants.py. Those are also the only schemeless values in _PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS, which the server allowlist in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source uses. Any new schemeless prompt sender must add its value to that frozenset. The TypeScript literal cannot be imported, so it carries a pointer comment and must be kept in sync by hand.
Symptom: Changing one placeholder literal in a sender without updating the allowlist made prompt registration return 400 with no compile-time signal.
Constraints: Remote-scheme sources such as s3:// and mlflow-artifacts:/ are not placeholders and pass without listing. Editing the allowlist to add a value makes that value accepted for every prompt-tagged request, so keep the set minimal.
applies: Changes to prompt registration senders or the prompt source allowlist; not regular (non-prompt) model version creation.
says: Creating a new prompt version fails immediately with a bad request error.
The prompt creation screen gives an unexpected four hundred error when saving.
Saving a prompt template in the interface is rejected by the server.
Registering prompts from our client application encounters an unexpected validation failure.
Allow newly added prompt creation clients to save prompt versions successfully.
search: Prompt version creation sends fixed placeholder sources that must match the server allowlist in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source. The Python senders import _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('dummy-source') and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('prompt-template') from mlflow/prompt/constants.py, which are the only schemeless entries in _PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS. The UI prompt-creation call in api.ts uses a TypeScript literal that must be synced manually with the allowlist to avoid 400 errors. Remote schemes like s3:// and mlflow-artifacts:/ bypass placeholder validation, and the allowlist applies only to prompt-tagged requests rather than regular model versions.
